title: SG-2.7 Track game/public/assets/ui icons, frames and cursors with manifest entries
summary: Create game/public/assets/ui/{icons,frames,cursors}, each with one real SVG, and keep the matching manifest entries accurate.
description: Context: game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json already lists ui:icon-sound, ui:panel-frame and ui:cursor-pointer under ui/icons, ui/frames and ui/cursors. game/public/assets has no ui folder. The SVGs exist only under game/frontend/public/assets/ui. Desired behavior: each of the three folders under game/public/assets/ui holds one real pixel-art SVG tracked by git, and the manifest entries describe those files. Expected result: the folders are tracked and the manifest resolves to them. Why: git does not track empty folders, and the manifest should describe files that exist next to it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, When game/public/assets/ui/icons, frames and cursors are listed, Then each contains at least one non-empty .svg file
Given manifest.json, When ui:icon-sound, ui:panel-frame and ui:cursor-pointer paths are resolved under game/public/assets, Then every file exists
Given the manifest ui entries, When validated with parseManifest, Then validation succeeds and each dimensions value equals the width and height of its SVG

in_scope: Three new SVG files under game/public/assets/ui
dimensions fields on the three ui manifest entries
preserve: Existing manifest entries, ids and paths

technical_constraints: SVGs must use shape-rendering="crispEdges" like the existing assets
Manifest must still pass manifestSchema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts
definition_of_done: All requirements are met and their Verify units pass
